paras: Huynh's bent-toed gecko (Cyrtodactylus huynhi), also known commonly as Huynh's bow-fingered gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, huynhi, is in honor of Vietnamese biologist Dang Huy Huynh.
C. huynhi is found in southern Vietnam. The type locality is Chua Chan Mountain, Dong Nai Province.
The preferred natural habitats of C. huynhi are forest and dry caves, at altitudes of 70–300 m (230–980 ft).
